vulnerabilities.description: Spring Data Commons applications may be vulnerable to denial of service through resource exhaustion when attacker-controlled property path strings are passed to MappingContext property path resolution.
vulnerabilities.recommendation: No action required. Liquibase Secure resolves spring-data-commons 4.1.0, which is newer than the fixed 4.0.6 release.

ratings.justification: The resolved spring-data-commons version is newer than the fixed release, and the repository has no direct property-path resolution call sites.

analysis.detail: Spring Data Commons property-path DoS fixed in 4.0.6 and 3.5.12. Liquibase Secure resolves spring-data-commons 4.1.0 in the distribution license manifest (`core/liquibase-dist/src/main/archive/licenses/commercial/README.txt:958`), which is newer than the fixed 4.0.6 line. Repo search found no direct `MappingContext` or `PropertyPath` call sites in application code.
